effects.before: One fixed static-file package target had no same-C1 retained pre-effect intent/result journal.
effects.after: Under one lease the owner records exact source/plan/absence and Ready before copy, verifies copied bytes and A2 record before create-new result, and returns typed partial/recovery on interrupted duplicate; other package targets remain outside.
effects.platform: Selected GNU/Linux package journal tests; no native macOS/Windows runtime proof.

effects.before: One fixed offline Cargo target had no same-C1 pre-effect journal or verified retained result.
effects.after: The owner records source/plan/absence and Ready before Cargo/rustc commands, uses a project-local Cargo home, verifies selected binary and A2 record, and never respawns on duplicate; ambient toolchain/home side effects remain outside proof.
effects.platform: Selected GNU/Linux real four-process Cargo fixture; native macOS/Windows and unrestricted CAS unproved.

effects.before: The default stable reader refused any hard-linked output, including legitimate Cargo release/deps aliases.
effects.after: A public explicit opt-in reads a held nofollow regular file twice under a cap, checks stable metadata/link count and final-name identity; alias mutation outside the observed interval remains a cooperative detection-bound risk.
effects.platform: Selected GNU/Linux hardlink tests; native macOS/Windows observation and hostile-writer CAS unproved.

user_impact.reason: Additive public safefs API supports legitimate hard-linked Cargo outputs; fixed protected Build/Package entries remain internal, and existing users need no state migration.

documentation_impact.reason: Document the public linked-reader opt-in and its weaker alias/host contract, plus fixed Build/Package owner boundaries; final source page/editorial proof pending.
